behaviours.title: Balance of an account that was never opened is 0
behaviours.given: a new Ledger with no accounts
behaviours.then: the balance is 0 and the entries list is empty
behaviours.contrary_then: reading an unknown account fails with an error
contrary_alternatives: the balance is reported as undefined
the account is created implicitly and reported with balance 0 but the call is logged as an entry

behaviours.title: Opening an existing account does not reset it
behaviours.then: the balance stays 100 and the deposit entry is still listed
behaviours.contrary_then: the account is reset to a balance of 0 with no entries
contrary_alternatives: opening an existing account throws an error

behaviours.title: Deposit credits an account and records a deposit entry
behaviours.then: the result is ok, the balance is 100 and one 'deposit' entry of 100 is recorded
behaviours.contrary_then: the deposit is refused because account 'a' was never opened
contrary_alternatives: the deposit is accepted but no entry is recorded

behaviours.title: Deposit of zero is rejected as invalid-amount
behaviours.then: the result is not ok with reason 'invalid-amount' and the balance stays 0
behaviours.contrary_then: the zero deposit is accepted as a no-op with ok result
contrary_alternatives: the deposit is accepted and a 0 entry is recorded

behaviours.title: Negative deposit is rejected
behaviours.then: the result is 'invalid-amount' and the balance stays 100
behaviours.contrary_then: the negative deposit is accepted and the balance becomes 95
contrary_alternatives: the absolute value is deposited and the balance becomes 105

behaviours.title: Repeating a deposit txnId is accepted but applied only once
behaviours.when: 100 is deposited into 'a' again with the same txn 'd1'
behaviours.then: the result is ok but the balance stays 100 and only one entry exists
behaviours.contrary_then: the second deposit is applied and the balance becomes 200
contrary_alternatives: the second deposit is refused with a duplicate error

behaviours.title: Invalid amount is checked before duplicate txnId
behaviours.when: 0 is deposited with the same txn 'd1'
behaviours.then: the result is 'invalid-amount', not a silent ok
behaviours.contrary_then: the result is ok because the txnId was already seen
contrary_alternatives: the call is refused with a duplicate-transaction reason

behaviours.title: txnIds are shared across operation types
behaviours.when: 10 is withdrawn from 'a' using the same txn 'x1'
behaviours.then: the result is ok but nothing is withdrawn; the balance stays 100
behaviours.contrary_then: the withdrawal goes through and the balance becomes 89.5
contrary_alternatives: the withdrawal is refused with a duplicate-transaction reason

behaviours.title: Amounts are stored in whole cents: 0.1 + 0.2 = 0.3
behaviours.then: the balance is exactly 0.3
behaviours.contrary_then: the balance is 0.30000000000000004 (floating-point drift)
contrary_alternatives: the balance is 0.3 only after rounding to two places on read

behaviours.title: Half a cent rounds up: 10.005 becomes 10.01
behaviours.then: the balance is 10.01
behaviours.contrary_then: the balance is 10 (half-cent truncated)
contrary_alternatives: the deposit is refused for having more than two decimal places
the balance is 10.005 unrounded

behaviours.title: A deposit below half a cent is accepted but credits 0
behaviours.then: the result is ok, the balance is 0 and a deposit entry of amount 0 is recorded
behaviours.contrary_then: the deposit is refused as too small
contrary_alternatives: the deposit is rounded up to 0.01

behaviours.title: Foreign deposit converts amount by rate
behaviours.then: the result is ok, the balance is 110 and a 'deposit' entry of 110 is recorded
behaviours.contrary_then: the unconverted 100 is credited
contrary_alternatives: the amount is divided by the rate and 90.91 is credited

behaviours.title: Foreign deposit rounds converted half-cent up
behaviours.then: the balance is 0.13
behaviours.contrary_then: the balance is 0.12 (round half down / to even)
contrary_alternatives: the balance is 0.125 unrounded

behaviours.title: Foreign deposit rounds below-half cents down
behaviours.then: the balance is 1.23
behaviours.contrary_then: the balance is 1.24 (converted amount rounded up)
contrary_alternatives: the balance keeps full precision 1.2345

behaviours.title: Foreign deposit with zero rate is invalid-amount
behaviours.then: the result is 'invalid-amount' and the balance stays 0
behaviours.contrary_then: the result is 'amount-too-small'
contrary_alternatives: the deposit is accepted with a 0 credit

behaviours.title: Foreign deposit with zero amount is invalid-amount
behaviours.then: the result is 'invalid-amount'
behaviours.contrary_then: the call is accepted with ok
contrary_alternatives: the result is 'amount-too-small'

behaviours.title: Foreign deposit converting to under half a cent is amount-too-small
behaviours.then: the result is 'amount-too-small', balance 0, no account entries, and the txnId 'f1' is not consumed (a later 100 deposit with 'f1' succeeds)
behaviours.contrary_then: the deposit is accepted with ok and credits 0
contrary_alternatives: the converted amount is rounded up to 0.01 and credited

behaviours.title: Repeating a foreign deposit txnId is applied only once
behaviours.then: the result is ok and the balance stays 110
behaviours.contrary_then: the deposit is applied again and the balance becomes 220
contrary_alternatives: the call is refused as a duplicate

behaviours.title: Small withdrawal is charged the minimum fee of 0.50
behaviours.then: the result is ok, the balance becomes 89.5, and the 'withdrawal' entry amount is 10.5
behaviours.contrary_then: only a 1% fee of 0.10 is charged and the balance becomes 89.9
contrary_alternatives: no fee is charged and the balance becomes 90

behaviours.title: Withdrawal of 50 costs exactly the 0.50 minimum fee
behaviours.then: the balance becomes 49.5
behaviours.contrary_then: the fee is 1.00 and the balance becomes 49
contrary_alternatives: no fee is charged and the balance becomes 50

behaviours.title: Fee is 1% rounded up to the next cent
behaviours.then: the fee is 1.01 and the balance becomes 98.98
behaviours.contrary_then: the fee is rounded to 1.00 and the balance becomes 98.99
contrary_alternatives: the minimum fee of 0.50 is charged and the balance becomes 99.49

behaviours.title: Withdrawal of exactly 100 costs a fee of exactly 1.00
behaviours.then: the balance becomes 99 and the withdrawal entry amount is 101
behaviours.contrary_then: the fee rounds up to 1.01 and the balance becomes 98.99
contrary_alternatives: the fee is the 0.50 minimum and the balance becomes 99.5

behaviours.title: Large withdrawal fee is capped at 25.00
behaviours.when: 3000 is withdrawn with txn 'w1' (1% would be 30)
behaviours.then: the fee is 25 and the balance becomes 1975
behaviours.contrary_then: the uncapped fee of 30 is charged and the balance becomes 1970
contrary_alternatives: the withdrawal is refused because the fee exceeds the cap

behaviours.title: Withdrawal that uses the whole balance including fee is allowed
behaviours.then: the result is ok and the balance becomes 0
behaviours.contrary_then: the withdrawal is refused with 'insufficient-funds' and the balance stays 101
contrary_alternatives: the withdrawal is allowed but a minimum remaining balance is required, so it is refused

behaviours.title: Withdrawal is refused when the fee pushes it past the balance
behaviours.then: the result is 'insufficient-funds' and the balance stays 100
behaviours.contrary_then: the withdrawal is accepted because 99.5 alone fits within the balance
contrary_alternatives: the withdrawal goes through and the balance becomes -0.5
the fee is reduced to fit and the balance becomes 0

behaviours.title: A refused withdrawal does not consume its txnId
behaviours.given: account 'a' with balance 50; withdraw('a', 100, 'w1') was refused for insufficient funds
behaviours.when: 100 more is deposited (txn 'd2') and withdraw('a', 100, 'w1') is retried
behaviours.then: the retry succeeds and the balance becomes 49 (150 - 100 - 1.00 fee)
behaviours.contrary_then: the retry is silently ignored as a duplicate and the balance stays 150
contrary_alternatives: the retry is refused as a duplicate transaction

behaviours.title: Withdrawing from an account that was never funded is insufficient-funds
behaviours.then: the result is 'insufficient-funds' and the account now exists with balance 0 and no entries
behaviours.contrary_then: the result is an 'unknown-account' refusal
contrary_alternatives: the withdrawal goes through and the balance becomes -10.5

behaviours.title: Zero withdrawal is invalid-amount
behaviours.then: the result is 'invalid-amount' and the balance stays 100
behaviours.contrary_then: the zero withdrawal is accepted and the minimum fee of 0.50 is charged (balance 99.5)
contrary_alternatives: the zero withdrawal is accepted as a no-op

behaviours.title: Withdrawing exactly the 5000 daily limit is allowed
behaviours.given: account 'a' with balance 10000 and nothing withdrawn yet
behaviours.then: the result is ok and the balance becomes 4975 (5000 plus the capped 25 fee)
behaviours.contrary_then: the withdrawal is refused with 'daily-limit' and the balance stays 10000
contrary_alternatives: the fee is counted towards the limit, so the withdrawal is refused

behaviours.title: Withdrawing one cent over the 5000 daily limit is refused
behaviours.given: account 'a' with balance 10000 and nothing withdrawn yet
behaviours.then: the result is 'daily-limit' and the balance stays 10000
behaviours.contrary_then: the withdrawal is accepted and the balance becomes 4974.99
contrary_alternatives: the withdrawal is capped to 5000 and accepted

behaviours.title: Daily limit accumulates across withdrawals, excluding fees
behaviours.given: account 'a' with balance 6000; 2500 withdrawn twice (txns 'w1','w2'), leaving balance 950
behaviours.then: the first two withdrawals succeed, the third is refused with 'daily-limit' and the balance stays 950
behaviours.contrary_then: the third withdrawal succeeds and the balance becomes 948.5
contrary_alternatives: the second withdrawal is refused because fees count towards the limit

behaviours.title: Insufficient funds is reported before the daily limit
behaviours.then: the result reason is 'insufficient-funds'
behaviours.contrary_then: the result reason is 'daily-limit'
contrary_alternatives: the withdrawal goes through and the balance goes negative

behaviours.title: Daily limit is tracked per account
behaviours.given: accounts 'a' and 'b' each with balance 6000; 5000 already withdrawn from 'a' (txn 'w1')
behaviours.then: the withdrawal from 'b' succeeds and 'b' balance becomes 975
behaviours.contrary_then: the withdrawal from 'b' is refused with 'daily-limit' because the limit is shared
contrary_alternatives: the limit is ledger-wide and 'b' can withdraw nothing

behaviours.title: Transfer moves money with no fee and records both sides
behaviours.then: ok; 'a' is 20, 'b' is 30; 'a' has a 'transfer-out' entry of 30 and 'b' a 'transfer-in' entry of 30
behaviours.contrary_then: a withdrawal fee of 0.50 is taken and 'a' becomes 19.5
contrary_alternatives: the transfer is refused because 'b' was never opened

behaviours.title: Transfer of the entire balance is allowed
behaviours.then: ok; 'a' is 0 and 'b' is 50
behaviours.contrary_then: the transfer is refused with 'insufficient-funds'
contrary_alternatives: the transfer is allowed only up to leaving a positive balance

behaviours.title: Transfer one cent over the balance is refused
behaviours.then: 'insufficient-funds'; 'a' stays 50 and 'b' is 0
behaviours.contrary_then: the transfer goes through and 'a' becomes -0.01
contrary_alternatives: the available 50 is transferred and the rest dropped

behaviours.title: Zero transfer is invalid-amount
behaviours.then: 'invalid-amount'
behaviours.contrary_then: the transfer is accepted as a no-op
contrary_alternatives: zero-value entries are recorded on both sides

behaviours.title: Repeating a transfer txnId is applied only once
behaviours.given: account 'a' with balance 50 and transfer('a','b',20,'t1') already done
behaviours.then: ok; 'a' stays 30 and 'b' stays 20
behaviours.contrary_then: the transfer is applied again: 'a' becomes 10 and 'b' 40
contrary_alternatives: the repeat is refused as a duplicate

behaviours.title: Split gives the leftover cent to the first recipient
behaviours.then: ok; 'a' is 0, 'x' gets 33.34, 'y' 33.33, 'z' 33.33; 'a' has a 'split-out' entry of 100 and 'x' a 'split-in' of 33.34
behaviours.contrary_then: the leftover cent goes to the last recipient: 'x' 33.33 and 'z' 33.34
contrary_alternatives: each gets 33.33 and the leftover cent stays with 'a'

behaviours.title: Split remainder of 2 cents goes to the first two recipients
behaviours.contrary_then: the first recipient gets the whole remainder: 'x' 0.03, 'y' 0.01, 'z' 0.01
contrary_alternatives: the remainder goes to the last recipients: 'x' 0.01, 'y' 0.02, 'z' 0.02

behaviours.title: Split over the balance is refused and nothing moves
behaviours.then: 'insufficient-funds'; 'a' stays 10 and 'x' and 'y' are 0
behaviours.contrary_then: the split goes through and 'a' becomes -0.01
contrary_alternatives: the available 10 is split 5/5

behaviours.title: Split with no recipients is refused, even for a seen txnId
behaviours.given: account 'a' with balance 10 funded by txn 'd1'
behaviours.then: 'no-recipients' and 'a' stays 10
behaviours.contrary_then: the call returns ok because txnId 'd1' was already seen
contrary_alternatives: the money is debited from 'a' and lost

behaviours.title: Split with zero amount and no recipients reports invalid-amount first
behaviours.then: 'invalid-amount'
behaviours.contrary_then: 'no-recipients'
contrary_alternatives: the call is accepted as a no-op

behaviours.title: Repeating a split txnId is applied only once
behaviours.given: account 'a' with balance 100 and split('a',['x','y'],20,'s1') already done
behaviours.then: ok; 'a' stays 80 and 'x' stays 10
behaviours.contrary_then: the split is applied again: 'a' becomes 60 and 'x' 20
contrary_alternatives: the repeat is refused as a duplicate

behaviours.title: Interest for a full year uses a 365-day year
behaviours.then: ok; 50 interest is credited, balance 1050, with an 'interest' entry of 50
behaviours.contrary_then: a 360-day year is used and 50.69 is credited (balance 1050.69)
contrary_alternatives: the rate is applied as a fraction (5 = 500%) and 5000 is credited

behaviours.title: Partial-cent interest is rounded down
behaviours.then: 4.10 is credited and the balance becomes 1004.1
behaviours.contrary_then: interest is rounded to the nearest cent, 4.11, and the balance becomes 1004.11
contrary_alternatives: simple monthly interest of 1/12 year gives 4.17

behaviours.title: Interest that rounds to zero is ok, records nothing, and leaves the txnId reusable
behaviours.when: applyInterest('a', 1, 1, 'i1') (exact interest 0.0027 cents), then 999 more is deposited and applyInterest('a', 5, 365, 'i1') is called
behaviours.then: the first call is ok with no interest entry and balance 1; the second call credits 50 and the balance becomes 1050
behaviours.contrary_then: the second call is ignored because 'i1' was already used, leaving balance 1000
contrary_alternatives: the first call is refused as 'amount-too-small'
the first call rounds up and credits 0.01

behaviours.title: Interest with zero rate or zero days is invalid-amount
behaviours.then: both return 'invalid-amount' and the balance stays 1000
behaviours.contrary_then: both are accepted as ok with no interest
contrary_alternatives: zero rate is accepted as ok but zero days is refused

behaviours.title: Repeating an interest txnId is applied only once
behaviours.given: account 'a' with balance 1000 and applyInterest('a',5,365,'i1') already applied (balance 1050)
behaviours.then: ok; the balance stays 1050
behaviours.contrary_then: interest is applied again on 1050 and the balance becomes 1102.5
contrary_alternatives: the repeat is refused as a duplicate
